intro: The Armory is the fortified martial wing of the Scarlet Monastery, dedicated to manufacturing weapons and training recruits for the Scarlet Crusade. Behind locked iron gates, ranks of zealous footmen and crusaders drill under the fierce command of Herod, the Scarlet Champion.

p: Once part of a peaceful retreat for Lordaeron's priesthood, the monastery was completely overhauled following the Third War. The Armory now serves as the Crusade's primary forge, weapons depot, and combat proving ground. From the open training grounds to the deep weapon halls, ranks of Scarlet footmen, conjurers, and crusaders prepare relentlessly to purge the Scourge and anyone else they deem tainted. The wing remains locked away from the Grand Vestibule, accessible only to those carrying the Scarlet Key found in the neighboring Library.

At the heart of the wing lies the Hall of Champions, lined with towering statues dedicated to legendary heroes of the Crusade's past. The hall is overseen by Herod, a brutal warrior whose ferocity and whirlwinds are legendary among the crusaders. Herod trains the next generation of zealots personally; when hard-pressed in battle, his desperate recruits will pour into the chamber to fight and die for their champion.
